title: Length bound for the output
statement: For every finite bit string $w$, process its bits from left to right with a Boolean state initially false: on reading $b$, emit $b$ exactly when the current state is true, and update the state to true if it was already true or if $b=0$. The resulting output string has length at most $|w|$.
